animationConventions: Forward is local +Z, up is +Y. Main Turret yaw is absolute ship-local yaw; Elevation rotation.x = -elevation. Auxiliary Mount stores rest baseYaw; animate Mount to absolute ship-local yaw and Pivot.rotation.x = -elevation. Rear/rest bank yaw must not be added twice. Recoil translates barrel local Z negatively from zero; never translate the pivot or muzzle independently.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
naming: GLB node names retain controlId colons; Three GLTFLoader sanitizes colons. Use loadedNode/loadedPivot/loadedMuzzleNames after loading (or userData.name for original names).
